what: The pupil inside the white of the eye looks toward the cursor from anywhere on screen — it travels the eye radius minus the pupil radius and 12px, but when the cursor is within 120px the travel scales down in proportion to the distance (.25s power2.out). When the cursor leaves the window it returns to center in .35s. So small eyes where the pupil nearly fills the white do not move. · The ”spring” type has several eyes on one panel — the cursor position inside the panel (±.5 from center) times 48 moves the pupil layer as a % of its own size, following with a wobble of spring .03, damping .93 and a max of 2.4% per frame. On touch devices it looks only up and down (±100%) based on where the panel passes through the screen. · The ”glance” type has the two pupils of a face drawing aiming at the cursor in steps every 140ms (5 horizontal and 3 vertical units, less within 300px), following in jerks by .45 per frame, and on phones it looks in a random direction every .6 to 1.8 seconds.

options.margin: Gap to leave from the edge of the white (px), default 12
options.reach: Within this distance (px) it moves less in proportion to distance, default 120 — 0 means always go all the way · glance default is 300
options.mode: If ”spring”, the element it is attached to is the panel and the [data-fx-part inside=pupil] layers all move together (the layer sits inside the eye-white frame, and the white is drawn by whoever uses it) — Brand A Hero character eyes · with ”glance” the attached element is the panel, and the pupils inside (an SVG g works too) snap toward the cursor every every ms, following by follow each time — Brand B face
options.max: spring: how far the pupil layer travels at the plate edge (% of its own size) × 2, default 48 — 24% when the cursor is at the plate edge
options.touch: spring: amount applied via scroll on touch devices (%), default 100
options.speed: spring: max movement per frame (%), default 2.4
options.mx · my: glance: the end point the pupils travel to (horizontal·vertical, in graphic units inside an SVG, otherwise px), default 5 · 3
options.every: glance: aiming interval (ms) — even if the mouse stops, it aims again every every+20ms, default 140
options.follow: glance: share of the remaining distance followed each frame, default .45 (1 with reduced motion)
